description: This file defines an Android activity class named TableLayout9 that demonstrates toggling the column shrinkability of a TableLayout via a button. It includes setting the content view, referencing UI elements, and setting an event listener to change layout properties dynamically.

classes.name: TableLayout9
classes.description: Android activity that demonstrates toggling the shrinkable property of a table column using a button.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, configures button behavior, and initializes the shrink state of the column.
